Its glass was green, its cork sealed with wax, and inside lay a page covered in salt-stiff handwriting. The message named a ship that had vanished forty years earlier and gave a date: tonight. Ellis laughed at first, then saw the final line: “Keep the north lamp dark.” All day the sea gathered itself beneath low clouds. At sunset, he climbed the spiral stairs, listening to the old tower groan. When midnight arrived, a ship’s bell rang beyond the reef. Ellis covered the northern pane. In darkness, a ghostly vessel passed safely through the channel and vanished into rain.","w02":"凌晨四点，城市像一台暂时停下的机器。高架桥上偶有货车驶过，轮胎声在空楼之间拉得很长。便利店的灯还亮着，店员伏在柜台边打盹，咖啡机发出轻微的响声。路灯把树影投在人行道上，风吹过，影子缓慢摇晃。远处写字楼的窗格只剩零星灯火，像未熄的星。清洁车沿街缓缓前行，带走昨夜的纸屑和喧闹。天色仍深，却已有鸟鸣从屋檐下传来。","w03":"- Recursion is when a function solves a problem by calling itself with a smaller version of that problem.\n- It needs a stopping rule, called a base case, so it does not call itself forever.\n- Imagine opening nested boxes: open one box, then do the same thing until you reach the smallest box."}
